as_told.title: Betty and Barney Hill abduction came days after an Outer Limits episode

plain: The Outer Limits, a science fiction TV show on CBS, is said to have aired its first episode about 11 days before Betty and Barney Hill had the experience they later described as being abducted by aliens. Michels takes this from American Cosmic, a book by the writer Diana Pasulka, and raises it in two episodes. Its point is that a TV show may have shaped one of the most famous abduction stories.
